text: Worst experience ever. Staff was extremely rude and unprofessional. Waited 45 minutes for cold food. Never coming back.
Absolutely amazing! Best restaurant in the city. Food was fresh, staff was friendly and service was super fast.
Very disappointed. The burger was dry and tasteless. McDonald's nearby is honestly way better than this place.
Great food and nice ambiance. Service was a bit slow but overall a good experience. Will come back.
Terrible service. The waiter was rude and ignored us for 30 minutes. Food was cold when it arrived. Disgusting.
Outstanding experience from start to finish. The chef came out personally and the desserts were incredible.
Average food, nothing special. Prices are too high for what you get. Subway gives better value honestly.
Absolutely disgusting. Found a hair in my food. Manager was not apologetic at all. Health department should visit.
Perfect date night spot. Romantic atmosphere, excellent wine selection and the pasta was cooked to perfection.
Overpriced and underwhelming. Staff seemed annoyed by customers. Will not recommend to anyone.
Really enjoyed the brunch menu. Fresh ingredients and creative dishes. Parking can be an issue on weekends.
Waited 1 hour for a table with reservation. Food was wrong twice. Complete waste of money and time.
Best pizza I have ever had. Authentic Italian style, crispy crust and generous toppings. Highly recommend.
Decent place but nothing memorable. Food was okay, service was average. Might come back if nearby.
Rude staff and dirty tables. KFC has better customer service than this expensive restaurant. Shameful.
Incredible food quality and presentation. Every dish was a masterpiece. The tasting menu is worth every penny.
Very slow service. Took 20 minutes just to get water. Food was cold and bland. Expected much better.
Lovely family dinner. Kids menu was great, staff was patient with children. Good portion sizes and fair prices.
Never going back. Order was completely wrong, staff argued when we complained. Absolutely unacceptable behavior.
Hidden gem of the city. Cozy atmosphere, authentic recipes and the owner personally greets every customer.
Disappointing visit. The meat was overcooked and chewy. Burger King does a better job at half the price.
Solid choice for business lunch. Quick service, good food quality and reasonable prices. Reliable spot.
Absolutely terrible. Waited 2 hours, food arrived cold, manager refused to give refund. Reporting to health board.
Phenomenal dining experience. The sommelier recommended perfect wine pairings. Will definitely celebrate here again.
Okay experience overall. Food was fine but not outstanding. Service was neither good nor bad. Just average.
Worst pizza in town. Dough was raw in the middle. Dominos is ten times better and cheaper. Never again.
Exceptional service and food quality. The chef accommodated my dietary restrictions perfectly. Truly five stars.
Not impressed at all. Small portions for high prices. Staff was inattentive and forgot half our order.
Great atmosphere and good food. The cocktail menu is creative and bartender was very knowledgeable. Enjoyable night.
Food poisoning after eating here. Spent entire night sick. This place should be shut down immediately.
Best sushi in the entire city. Fish is incredibly fresh, rolls are creative and presentation is beautiful.
Mixed experience. Some dishes were great, others were mediocre. Service was inconsistent throughout the meal.
Disgusting hygiene standards. Kitchen was visible and looked filthy. Staff handling food without gloves. Reported.
Romantic and elegant. Perfect for anniversaries. The chocolate lava cake is the best dessert I have ever tasted.
Very average food at premium prices. The steak was overcooked despite ordering medium rare. Disappointing.
Enjoyed the Sunday brunch buffet. Wide variety of dishes, everything was fresh and regularly replenished.
Staff was incredibly rude to my elderly mother. Refused to accommodate her seating needs. Disgraceful behavior.
Absolutely delightful. Every single dish was prepared with care and creativity. Service was attentive without being intrusive.
Decent burger place. Nothing special but gets the job done. Fries were crispy which is always a plus.
Waited over an hour for delivery that never came. Called multiple times, no answer. Worst service ever.
Incredible value for money. Large portions, fresh ingredients and friendly service. My new favorite restaurant.
Very disappointed with the quality. Food tasted microwaved, not freshly cooked. Expected much better from reviews.
Great date night option. Cozy private booths, excellent wine list and attentive service. Will return.
Zero stars if possible. Manager was dismissive of our complaint. Pizza Hut treats customers better than this place.
World class dining. The tasting menu was a journey through flavors. Each course better than the last.
Standard diner food. Comfortable seating and quick service but nothing that stands out from the competition.
Food arrived 90 minutes late and was completely cold. Driver was unapologetic. Refund request ignored completely.
Simply the best. Consistent quality every single visit. Staff remembers your name and preferences. Exceptional place.
Poorly managed kitchen. Long waits, inconsistent food quality. Some dishes were good but overall not worth it.
Really nice place for a group dinner. Staff handled our large table well and food came out together.
Absolutely appalling. Raw chicken served to my child. This is a serious health hazard. Authorities contacted.
Magical experience. The chef creates edible art. Every dish tells a story. Worth every single penny spent.
Hit and miss. Some visits are great, others disappointing. Consistency is the main issue with this place.
Rude owner argued with us over a small complaint. We will never return and telling everyone we know.
Delightful brunch spot. Avocado toast was perfect, coffee was excellent and service was warm and welcoming.
Starbucks next door has better ambiance than this so called premium cafe. Overpriced and underwhelming coffee.
Good food and fair prices. The lunch special is excellent value. Convenient location with easy parking.
Three visits, three disappointments. Management clearly does not care about quality or customer satisfaction. Avoid.
Perfect in every way. Fresh ingredients, creative menu, attentive staff and reasonable prices. Cannot fault it.
Average experience. Food was fine but the noise level made it hard to have a conversation. Okay place.
Unbelievably bad. Wrong order, cold food, rude staff and management that does not care. Total disaster.
Hands down the best dining experience in the city. Innovative dishes, superb service and beautiful presentation.
Mediocre at best. The portions have gotten smaller while prices keep going up. Not worth it anymore.
Enjoyed every dish we ordered. The lamb chops were perfectly cooked and the dessert selection was impressive.
Staff chatting on phones while customers wait. Manager nowhere to be seen. Absolutely zero professionalism here.
Incredible hospitality. Felt like dining at a friends home. Food was comforting, generous and absolutely delicious.
Okay for a quick meal. Nothing to rave about but nothing terrible either. Convenient location saves it.
Gave them three chances and all three times were terrible. Poorly trained staff and inconsistent food quality.
Exceptional farm to table concept. Freshest ingredients, creative seasonal menu and passionate knowledgeable staff.
Really let down. Reservation for 7pm, seated at 8pm with no apology. Food was rushed and mediocre.
Solid neighborhood restaurant. Reliable quality, friendly faces and good value. Perfect for regular weekly visits.
Overcooked steak, wrong sides, cold soup. When complained the waiter rolled his eyes. Never ever again.
Simply outstanding. The flavor combinations are genius. Every visit is a new culinary adventure worth experiencing.
The food is good but the wait times are frustrating. Need better kitchen management during peak hours.
Absolutely shocking service. Spilled drink on my laptop, offered no compensation. Manager was completely unhelpful.
Five stars without hesitation. The attention to detail in every aspect of the dining experience is remarkable.
Went for birthday dinner, ruined by inattentive staff and wrong dishes. Complete opposite of a celebration.
Great spot for after work drinks and light bites. Happy hour deals are fantastic and staff are fun.
Worst night out in years. Bouncer was aggressive, drinks were watered down and music was unbearably loud.
Truly world class. The head chef is a genius. This restaurant deserves every award and recognition it gets.
Good location and nice decor but the menu is overpriced for what you actually get on the plate.
Food gave us both food poisoning. Spent the whole next day ill. Environmental health has been notified.
Wonderful family restaurant. Kids loved the special menu and staff went above and beyond to make them happy.
Service has gone downhill since new management took over. Regular customer but not for much longer sadly.
Really impressed with the vegan options. Thoughtful menu design and execution. Great to see inclusive dining.
Filthy toilets, sticky floors, rude staff. How does this place still have a license to operate food?
Every single thing about this restaurant is perfect. From the welcome to the farewell. An unforgettable experience.
Middle of the road experience. Some positives and some negatives but overall just an average meal out.
Reservation lost, no table available, no apology offered. Turned away at the door on our anniversary. Awful.
The best kept secret in town. Incredible food at very reasonable prices. Always leaves me wanting to return.
Slow, expensive and forgettable. There are ten better options within walking distance. Will not be returning here.
Lovely Sunday roast. Generous portions, properly cooked vegetables and excellent gravy. Traditional done properly here.
Zero customer care. Complained about undercooked fish, staff laughed. This is a public health risk situation.
Absolutely blown away. Innovative cuisine, impeccable service and stunning presentation. A truly memorable dining experience.
Tried it twice now. Inconsistent quality is the problem. First visit great, second visit disappointing. Hit or miss.
Aggressive manager, dismissive staff and inedible food. This place is an embarrassment to the restaurant industry.
Cannot recommend highly enough. Flawless from beginning to end. The kind of restaurant that restores your faith in dining.
Used to love this place but quality has dropped significantly. Portion sizes smaller and prices much higher now.
Thoroughly enjoyed our visit. Staff were knowledgeable about allergens which is really important for our family. Thank you.
Absolute nightmare from start to finish. Wrong food, wrong bill, rude staff and zero accountability from management.
